cases.name: held-unknown-member
cases.note: Row 1: a member this version does not know. The other version is held, nothing is made.

cases.name: held-local-unknown-member
cases.note: Row 1 is symmetric: this device's version cannot be read either.

cases.name: held-unsupported-document
cases.note: Row 1: a document version this app does not know.

cases.name: same-deleted-here-untouched-there
cases.note: Row 2: deleted here, untouched there. The item ends up in Recently Deleted once; this version is sent on top.

cases.name: same-untouched-here-deleted-there
cases.note: Row 2: the other version is the record as it is (adoptsOther), and nothing is sent.

cases.name: same-restored-here-deleted-there
cases.note: Row 2: restored on one device and deleted on the other: it stays deleted.

cases.name: same-live-here-legacy-deleted-there
cases.note: Row 2: (deletedAt, deletedWithJournal) is one unit. An entry an earlier version deleted with its journal, against a live one, is deleted with its journal.

cases.name: same-deleted-here-legacy-deleted-there
cases.note: Row 2: both deleted: the pair that is deleted with its journal wins, whichever is later.

cases.name: same-legacy-here-deleted-there
cases.note: Row 2: the same, the other way round.

cases.name: same-both-deleted
cases.note: Row 2: both deleted the ordinary way: the other version's pair, whatever the times.

cases.name: same-written-differently
cases.note: Row 2 compares decoded values, never bytes: the same members in another order and with white space.

cases.name: same-modified-time-only
cases.note: The modified time is informational and is not content.

cases.name: differs-title
cases.note: Row 3 (entries and templates that differ): the title.

cases.name: differs-title-normalization-only
cases.note: Titles that are canonically equivalent but not the same code points are different: strings are compared by code points, never normalized.

cases.name: differs-date
cases.note: The entry date.

cases.name: differs-journal
cases.note: The journal.

cases.name: differs-archived
cases.note: archivedAt.

cases.name: differs-text
cases.note: The text.

cases.name: differs-block-identities-only
cases.note: A version that differs only in metadata.blockIDs is different, strictly: every client agrees.

cases.name: differs-segment-lengths-only
cases.note: Only metadata.segmentLengths differs: different.

cases.name: differs-image-types-only
cases.note: Only metadata.imageTypes differs: different.

cases.name: differs-integer-written-with-a-fraction
cases.note: Numbers are compared by kind and value: the integer 14 and 14.0 are different, as are true and 1. Another writer's 14.0 where this version has 14 is a difference, never the same content.

cases.name: differs-template
cases.note: A template that differs is kept for review like an entry.

cases.name: copy-other-in-recently-deleted
cases.note: Row 3: the other version was deleted. Each version stays where it is: the copy keeps R's deletion state.

copy.markdown:
A first line
and a second.
copy.title: A first line (other version)

cases.name: copy-untitled-uses-the-first-line
cases.note: Row 3: R has no title. The title the lists show for it is used: its first line.

cases.name: copy-untitled-first-line-cut-at-60-clusters
cases.note: Row 3: the first line is cut at 60 extended grapheme clusters: 59 letters and the family emoji, which is one cluster of five scalars.

copy.markdown:
A first line
and a second.
copy.title: A first line (other version)

cases.name: copy-white-space-title-uses-the-first-line
cases.note: Row 3: a title with only White_Space characters (spaces, a tab, a no-break space, an em space) is none: the title the lists show is used.

cases.name: copy-white-space-first-line-uses-the-catalog-name
cases.note: Row 3: R has no title and its first line that is not empty has only White_Space characters (here one no-break space, which a Markdown reader keeps as the line): the catalog's name, not the next line.

cases.name: copy-untitled-and-empty
cases.note: Row 3: R has neither a title nor text. The lists show it as a new entry, and so does the copy.

cases.name: copy-title-already-suffixed
cases.note: Row 3: the suffix is always appended, never detected. A copy of a copy reads twice.

cases.name: copy-drops-the-restoration-marker
cases.note: Row 3: restoredFromDeletionID is marker bookkeeping of the record, not of a version; the copy has none.

cases.name: copy-of-a-template
cases.note: Row 3 for a template: a separate template, the title with the same suffix.

cases.name: copy-with-an-image
cases.note: Row 3: the copy refers to the same attachment, by the same identity. No bytes are copied.

cases.name: entry-edited-here-deleted-for-good-there
cases.note: Row 4: the marker is the record; the edited version is parked as a new entry in Recently Deleted.

cases.name: entry-deleted-for-good-here-edited-there
cases.note: Row 4: this device's marker stays the record (sent on top); the other version is parked.

cases.name: untitled-entry-parked
cases.note: Row 4: the title is unchanged, even when empty.

cases.name: entry-in-recently-deleted-edited-there
cases.note: Row 4: an edited version that was in Recently Deleted is parked deleted at the marker's time.

cases.name: template-edited-here-deleted-for-good-there
cases.note: Row 4 for a template.

cases.name: two-markers
cases.note: Row 5: two permanent deletions. The other device's marker is the record.

cases.name: journal-renamed-on-both
cases.note: Row 6: this device's name stays and the other name is noted; the other version is kept in history.

cases.name: journal-renamed-normalization-only
cases.note: Row 6: names that differ only in normalization are different names: the other name is noted.

cases.name: journal-template-only
cases.note: Row 6: equal names, different default template: this device's, without a note.

cases.name: journal-same-content
cases.note: Row 2 for a journal: the same name and template are not a conflict.

cases.name: journal-renamed-here-deleted-there
cases.note: Row 6: deleted wins (the deletion state is merged) and this device's name stays.

cases.name: journal-edited-here-deleted-for-good-there
cases.note: Row 7: the marker is the record; no journal is made, because a copy would not carry entries.

cases.name: journal-deleted-for-good-here-edited-there
cases.note: Row 7: the other way round.

purpose: Two versions of one record as exact plaintext (local is this device's, other is the other device's) and what settling them produces (protocol/conflicts.md, The rules). Copy and parked identities use the vault key of crypto/encryption-v2.json. See README.md in this folder.
